channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Corsair Cove
item.description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

item.title: Mr. President
item.description: Can you face the challenges of the Oval Office? Find out in Mr. President, a sandbox simulation of the U.S. presidency. Pursue your legislative agenda. Compete with rivals Russia and China. Deal with crises from 9/11 to COVID-19; and direct the U.S. military against terror groups and rogue states.

item.title: Quasimorph - Supporter Pack
item.description: If you enjoyed the game and want to support our team, purchasing this pack is the best way to express yourself!

item.title: The Sims™ 4 Vampires
item.description: Transform your Sims into powerful vampires and live for eternity in an eerie new destination with The Sims™ 4 Vampires.

item.title: WARSHIFT 2
item.description: WARSHIFT 2 blends RTS, Action, and RPG progression. Build bases and command troops, mechs, battleships, and aircraft carriers. Then take direct control of your hero and fight alongside your army. Customize your heroes with weapons and upgrades.

item.title: Waterpark Simulator
item.description: Build and run your own waterpark solo or with friends. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!

item.title: DragonSword : Awakening - Costume : Coral Summer Mischief
item.description: Purchasing this content lets you obtain "Coral Summer Mischief" which adorns Astria's outfit, and "Sunshine Heartshot" which adorns the weapon's appearance.

item.title: DragonSword : Awakening - Costume : White Flower of the Blue Waves
item.description: Purchasing this content lets you obtain "White Flower of the Blue Waves" which adorns Reina's outfit, and "Petals at the Wave's Edge" which adorns the weapon's appearance.

item.title: Wolfenstein: Youngblood
item.description: Wolfenstein: Youngblood is the first modern co-op Wolfenstein adventure. Team up with a friend or play solo as one of BJ Blazkowicz’s twin daughters and wield a powerful arsenal of new weapons, gadgets, and abilities to liberate Paris from the Nazis.

item.title: DEATHLOOP
item.description: DEATHLOOP is a next-gen FPS from Arkane Lyon, the award-winning studio behind Dishonored. In DEATHLOOP, two rival assassins are trapped in a mysterious timeloop on the island of Blackreef, doomed to repeat the same day for eternity.

item.title: Dishonored 2
item.description: Reprise your role as a supernatural assassin in Dishonored 2. Declared a “masterpiece” by Eurogamer and hailed “a must-play revenge tale” by Game Informer, Dishonored 2 is the follow up to Arkane’s 1st-person action blockbuster & winner of 100+ 'Game of the Year' awards, Dishonored.

item.title: DOOM + DOOM II
item.description: Developed by id Software, and originally released in 1993 and 1994, the definitive, newly enhanced versions of DOOM + DOOM II are available as a combined product.

item.title: DOOM 3
item.description: A demonic invasion has overwhelmed the Union Aerospace Corporation's Mars research facility. As one of only a few survivors, you must fight your way to hell and back against a horde of demons in this award-winning horror/action FPS and reimagining of the original DOOM.

item.title: Fallout 4 VR
item.description: Fallout 4, the legendary post-apocalyptic adventure from Bethesda Game Studios and winner of more than 200 ‘Best Of’ awards, including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year, comes in its entirety to VR.

item.title: Fallout 76 - Deathclaw Pet Bundle
item.description: Receive your very own cuddly, carnivous companion with Fallout 76: Deathclaw Pet Bundle! Fallout 76 base game required, sold separately.

item.title: Fallout Tactics: Brotherhood of Steel
item.description: Tactical Squad-Based Combat comes to the Fallout® Universe! You are the wretched refuse. You may be born from dirt, but we will forge you into steel. You will learn to bend; if not you, will you break. In these dark times, the Brotherhood - your Brotherhood - is all that stands between the rekindled flame of civilization and the howling,...

item.title: Morbid Metal
item.description: Shapeshift into powerful characters in real time, chain impactful combos, and tear through waves of deadly machines and brutal bosses in this fast-paced hack-and-slash rogue-lite.

item.title: Need for Speed™
item.description: Ready to own the streets? Get behind the wheel of iconic cars and floor it through Ventura Bay, a sprawling urban playground. Explore overlapping stories as you build your reputation – and your dream car – and become the ultimate racing icon.

item.title: Need for Speed™ Payback
item.description: Set in the underworld of Fortune Valley, you and your crew were divided by betrayal and reunited by revenge to take down The House, a nefarious cartel that rules the city’s casinos, criminals and cops. In this corrupt gambler’s paradise, the stakes are high and The House always wins.

item.title: Need for Speed™ Rivals
item.description: Erase the line between single player and multiplayer in this street-racing rivalry between Cops and Racers. Seamlessly join a world where your friends are already racing and chasing

item.title: PARKSIDE: DECAYED SOUL MANIPULATION
item.description: PARKSIDE is an FPS-Immersive Sim that chronicles the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering. Shoot, hack, and either save or sour the future of humanity in the dystopian city of Abbotsford, California in the awful year of 2038. Will you serve the Divine Rod?

item.title: The Evil Within
item.description: Developed by Shinji Mikami -- creator of the seminal Resident Evil series -- and the talented team at Tango Gameworks, The Evil Within embodies the meaning of pure survival horror. Highly-crafted environments, horrifying anxiety, and an intricate story are combined to create an immersive world that will bring you to the height of tension.

item.title: The Evil Within 2
item.description: Detective Sebastian Castellanos has lost everything, including his daughter, Lily. To save her, he must descend into the nightmarish world of STEM. Horrifying threats emerge from every corner, and he must rely on his wits to survive. For his one chance at redemption, the only way out is in.

item.title: Wolfenstein: The New Order
item.description: Wolfenstein®: The New Order reignites the series that created the first-person shooter genre. Wolfenstein offers a deep game narrative packed with action, adventure and first-person combat.

item.title: Wolfenstein: The Old Blood
item.description: Wolfenstein®: The Old Blood™ is a standalone prequel to the critically acclaimed first-person action-adventure shooter, Wolfenstein®: The New Order. This adventure spans eight chapters and features the hallmarks of MachineGames – thrilling action, immersive story, and intense FPS combat.
